verdict.rationale: Edge0's first-party GitHub docs show an official `edge0` CLI. It serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with `edge0 serve edge0-35b`, runs one-shot chat with flags like --max-new and --show-thinking, and accepts --no-prerouter / --no-lora toggles, with a macOS local CLI/daemon listed alongside. Missing for 10: a complete CLI command reference, CLI coverage of model download (fetching still uses a Python script), clear CLI availability on platforms beyond the shown commands and macOS, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
